payload.title: push_prepared_branch re-reads the proposal's approval through require_operator_approval alone and omits the status == approved_for_apply precondition that prepare_branch and commit_prepared_branch both enforce, so a proposal whose latest row left approved_for_apply but kept approval_source operator still pushes under strict
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/pr_manager.py:998-999 (prepare_branch refuses a proposal not in approved_for_apply)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/pr_manager.py:1047-1048 (commit_prepared_branch refuses a proposal not in approved_for_apply)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/pr_manager.py:1103-1116 (the push comment says the approval is re-read as the two siblings do, and the call checks approval_source only)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/proposal.py:103-112 (get_proposal returns the latest row for the id, whatever its status)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/proposal.py:223-243 (approval_source_of reads the declared approval_source and never looks at status)
aria-kernel/tests/test_pr_manager_e2e.py:1536-1548 (the withdrawal fixture clears approval_source together with status, so a status-only change is unpinned)
aria-kernel/tests/test_pr_manager_e2e.py:1591-1595 (the only withdrawal pin passes whether or not push checks status)
payload.rule_violated: ARIA-MEDIUM-1109 intent as written in the push comment: the push re-reads the approval 'as prepare_branch and commit_prepared_branch do'; the lane's other two steps both gate on status == approved_for_apply.
payload.notes: Append a proposals row for the same proposal_id with status 'open' (or any value other than approved_for_apply) and approval_source still 'operator'. get_proposal returns that row, require_operator_approval sees source 'operator' and passes, enforce_profile_for_action passes under strict, and git push -u runs, putting the aria/* branch on the remote for a proposal the lane no longer treats as approved. No production writer produces such a row today (record_proposal mints fresh ids and _write_approval only sets approved_for_apply), so it is reachable only through a hand-appended ledger row; it becomes reachable as soon as any writer changes status without clearing the approval fields. Close condition: push_prepared_branch refuses with a named GovernanceError when the proposal's status is not approved_for_apply, using the same check as commit_prepared_branch, and PushIsAGovernedActionTests gains a case that appends a row with status open and approval_source operator and asserts the refusal before any git call, intent row or push row. Verified at origin/main a81bfa2d6.
